name: g_cameraTargetFilterAll
comment: Option bytes handed to Camera_IsCandidateVisible: byte 0 also rejects candidates whose hidden flag is set, byte 1 also rejects candidates farther away than their own radius. Both are 1 here (bytes 01 01 00 00), so Camera_BuildVisibleTargetLists applies every filter; the recovered code only reads bytes 0-1.
evidence: Literals 0x0062DA5C (Camera_BuildVisibleTargetLists 0x0062D930: Camera_IsCandidateVisible(self,i,ref,g_0062da5c,arg2)) and 0x0062DBE0 (maybe_Camera_FindVisibleCandidate 0x0062DA68) pass it as the flags pointer; the callee 0x0062D49C reads flags[0] (-> candidate f_7a hidden test) and flags[1] (distance vs f_4c radius). Image bytes at 0x007272A4: 01 01 00 00.

name: g_cameraTargetFilterNoRadius
comment: Same option pair as g_cameraTargetFilterAll but byte 1 is 0, so only the hidden-flag test runs and the distance/radius test is skipped. maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList passes it while re-validating an actor-derived camera target (bytes 01 00 FF FF).
evidence: Sole literal 0x001D4620 in maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList (0x001D43C0): Camera_IsCandidateVisible(local_30,target,ref,g_001d4620,0); the callee 0x0062D49C only reads flags[0]/flags[1]. Image bytes: 01 00 FF FF.

name: g_cameraTargetEyeDistance
comment: Distance of the last camera transition eye position from the world origin (sqrt of the new eye vector), published by Camera_SetTransitionTarget and used by Camera_UpdateTransition to rebuild the eye as direction * distance. Starts at 0.0 and is rewritten on every transition.
